## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant version/changelog entry.

## Validation

Record exact final head, commands, results and limitations. Distinguish local checks from remote CI and synthetic checks from real inference.

## Review and release

- [ ] Intended source diff reviewed; staged and history privacy audits passed.
- [ ] Applicable build/tests and `python3 tools/check_release.py` passed.
- [ ] English and Chinese guides agree; release metadata updated if releasing.
- [ ] Native subagent reviewed the final head; findings resolved.
- [ ] Required GitHub checks/rules satisfied before subagent merge.
- [ ] Runtime deployment or data migration is described separately, if in scope.
